# City Desk — Complete 1,000-Page Local Trade Directory & Turnkey Fulfillment Specification
Engineered by Neal Frazier (Neal Frazier Tech | https://www.nealfrazier.tech | neal@nealfrazier.tech | (757) 576-0980).

## 20 Covered Service Trades
- **Painters** (`/services/painters/`): Interior, exterior, and a written price before the first can opens.
- **Plumbers** (`/services/plumbers/`): Leaks, drains, fixtures, and water heaters, with emergency work kept separate.
- **HVAC shops** (`/services/hvac/`): A tune-up path and a no-cool or no-heat path, written as two different visits.
- **Roofers** (`/services/roofers/`): Inspections, repairs, and full replacements, started from a ground photo.
- **Electricians** (`/services/electricians/`): Small repairs and panel work sorted into two paths before the truck rolls.
- **Garage door shops** (`/services/garage-doors/`): A stuck door, a spring, or an opener, with the symptom in the first line.
- **Landscapers** (`/services/landscapers/`): Weekly maintenance and one-time cleanups as two different bookings.
- **House cleaners** (`/services/cleaners/`): A recurring clean and a first deep clean, with supplies and pets answered.
- **Mobile detailers** (`/services/detailers/`): A mobile visit at the driveway, with packages named in words and prices said before the day.
- **Junk removal** (`/services/junk-removal/`): A load priced from photos, plus a short list of what will not be hauled.
- **Pest control** (`/services/pest-control/`): Ants, cockroaches, and rodents, with a one-time visit and a recurring plan.
- **Movers** (`/services/movers/`): Local moves priced from rooms, stairs, and a date.
- **Pet groomers** (`/services/groomers/`): Dogs, a first visit, and what to bring. Cats only if the owner adds them.
- **Dental offices** (`/services/dentists/`): A new-patient first visit, with insurance named by the office beside the phone.
- **Med spas** (`/services/med-spas/`): A consult page. A clinician decides what is appropriate. Results vary.
- **Gyms** (`/services/gyms/`): Who the gym is for, what the first week includes, and a start price said by the owner.
- **Restaurants** (`/services/restaurants/`): Hours, one house dish, and how to get a table tonight.
- **Food trucks** (`/services/food-trucks/`): This week’s stops, three items, and what happens in bad weather.
- **Auto repair shops** (`/services/auto-repair/`): An estimate you can read before the car is repaired, and a list of work the shop does not guess at.
- **Property managers** (`/services/property-managers/`): A door for owners and a different door for tenants, with the fee in plain words.
